tool_uses.command: ls -la; cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null; git status --short; rg -n '"test"|pytest|\[tool' package.json pyproject.toml Makefile 2>/dev/null | head

LOG="$HOME/test-run-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"; echo "$LOG" > /tmp/lastlog_path
{
echo "Date: $(date)"; echo "Commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"; echo "Command: python3 -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider"; echo "-----"
} > "$LOG"
START=$(date +%s)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider >> "$LOG" 2>&1; RC=$?
END=$(date +%s)
{ echo "-----"; echo "Exit code: $RC"; echo "Wall time: $((END-START))s"; } >> "$LOG"
echo "$LOG"; cat "$LOG"; git status --short
cat test_calculator.py calculator.py; which pytest; ls ~/.pyenv 2>/dev/null | head -2

rm -f "$(cat /tmp/lastlog_path)"
LOG="$HOME/test-run-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
{ echo "Date: $(date)"; echo "Commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"; echo "Command: python3 -m unittest discover -v"; echo "-----"; } > "$LOG"
START=$(date +%s)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -v >> "$LOG" 2>&1; RC=$?
END=$(date +%s)
{ echo "-----"; echo "Exit code: $RC"; echo "Wall time: $((END-START))s"; } >> "$LOG"
echo "$LOG"; cat "$LOG"; git status --short; git ls-files
